lines: Grown great on glory, compassion, waking, boundless bliss,
knowledge-lit in might — he wins, the Unbeaten.
sanskrit_cite: yaḥ sphītaḥ śrīdayābodhaparamānandasampadā vidyoddyotitamāhātmyaḥ sa jayaty aparājitaḥ
notes: 2026-11-04 owner review: pity -> compassion (dayā = viśvānugrahātmaka parecchāśaktiḥ per Kṣemarāja Vṛtti M00089).

lines: To the welling drop and hum, to the self of sheer nectar — hail;
to light unending, to Śaṅkara, the milk-white sea.
You we loathe, you we laud, with you we take counsel — O Ambikā's lord,
how lightly won, how well — the all you shouldered for us.
sanskrit_cite: dviṣmas tvāṃ tvāṃ stumas tubhyaṃ mantrayāmo 'mbikāpate ativāllabhyataḥ sādhu viśvaṅ no dhṛtavān asi

lines: To touch reined in and yoked, to nectar brimming full,
to sky-and-spell-shaped Vast, to Śambhu — hail.
sanskrit_cite: saṃhṛtasparśayogāya sampūrṇāmṛtasūtaye viyanmāyāsvarūpāya vibhave śambhave namaḥ

lines: What splits, unsplit; what severs, whole — we bend
to that all-shared shape of the Highest Lord.
sanskrit_cite: bhinneṣv api na bhinnaṃ yac chinneṣv achinnam eva ca namāmaḥ sarvasāmānyaṃ rūpaṃ tat pārameśvaram

lines: Finer than the sacred-syllable half-mora crown — to mote and mountain both,
wider than the world-egg — hail the traitless-traited, the Pillar.
sanskrit_cite: praṇavordhvārdhamātrāto 'py aṇave mahate punaḥ brahmāṇḍād api nairguṇyaguṇāya sthāṇave namaḥ

lines: Egg-bearer of the cosmos — of the sky-filler, the all-farer,
the High Swan's force — swanlike we sing.
sanskrit_cite: brahmāṇḍagarbhiṇīṃ vyomavyāpinaḥ sarvatogateḥ parameśvarahaṃsasya śaktiṃ haṃsīm iva stumaḥ

lines: Stocked with nothing, backed by no wall, they unfurl the world-canvas —
hail him, craft-famed Spearman.
sanskrit_cite: nirupādānasambhāram abhittāv eva tanvate jagaccitraṃ namas tasmai kalāślāghyāya śūline

lines: Dredged clean from illusion's deep — Self-lore, self-milked: grant,
come, O Hara-Swan, to us.
sanskrit_cite: māyājalodarāt samyag uddhṛtya vimalīkṛtam śivajñānaṃ svato dugdhaṃ dehy ehi harahaṃsa naḥ

lines: Past sixfold proof and parting, to the Partless One,
to the Single State of highest aim — our gift, Bhava, to you.
sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭpramāṇīparicchedabhedayoge 'py abhedine paramārthaikabhāvāya baliṃ yāmo bhavāya te
